golden.label: no_fault
golden.description: Baseline golden RTL; all tests pass with zero mismatches.

fault_acc_overflow.label: accumulator_overflow
fault_acc_overflow.description: Accumulator width narrowed from 32 to 16 bits; large partial sums overflow silently.

fault_wrong_sign.label: sign_extension_error
fault_wrong_sign.description: Weight register cast from signed to unsigned; negative weights zero-extend instead of sign-extend.

fault_off_by_one.label: loop_boundary_error
fault_off_by_one.description: Outer-product loop terminates at N-2 instead of N-1; last column of partial sums never accumulated.

fault_reset.label: reset_polarity_error
fault_reset.description: Reset polarity inverted (active-high instead of active-low); design never resets, producing stale output.
